text: 浪潮信息公告，公司拟向不超过35名特定投资者发行股票，募集资金总额不超过人民币90亿元，拟用于面向智能体规模化应用的新一代AI基础设施研发及产业化项目26亿元、面向绿色智算集群的液冷原生算力基础设施研发及产业化项目14亿元、多智能体协同存算融合算力基础设施关键技术研发项目14亿元、高密度算力装备智造与交付能力升级工程9亿元及补充流动资金27亿元。本次发行相关事项已于2026年9月11日经董事会审议通过，尚需履行相关审批程序。
text_en: Inspur Information announced that the company plans to issue shares to no more than 35 specific investors, with total funds raised not exceeding RMB 9 billion, intended for use in a new-generation AI infrastructure R&D and industrialization project for large-scale agent applications of RMB 2.6 billion, a liquid-cooling native computing infrastructure R&D and industrialization project for green intelligent computing clusters of RMB 1.4 billion, a multi-agent collaborative computing-storage integration infrastructure key technology R&D project of RMB 1.4 billion, a high-density computing equipment intelligent manufacturing and delivery capability upgrade project of RMB 900 million, and supplementary working capital of RMB 2.7 billion. The relevant matters of this issuance were deliberated and approved by the board of directors on September 11, 2026, and still require the fulfillment of relevant approval procedures.
